content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, brown, shriveled leaf — the tissue has completely died and dried out, with the leaf curled/twisted along its length. The tip and stem are still visible. There is no powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty coating (rules out Sooty_Mould), and no discrete lesions with dark borders typical of Anthracnose. Instead, the entire shoot/leaf has died back from the tip downward — classic progressive necrosis and dieback of the distal tissue.
